verdict.rationale: monday.com documents a first-party GraphQL platform API for interacting with workflows and automating processes, confirmed by a live llms.txt and an OpenAPI document. It also offers programmatic control of agents, real-time event subscriptions such as create_item and change_column_value, and an official MCP server. Nothing in the pack claims or shows that the API covers everything possible in the UI, so the depth of parity is unproven. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim or coverage documentation, evidence that UI-only areas (views, dashboards, admin settings, automations configuration) are reachable via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
